activities.activity_description: Move the project reactor based gpfdist from the spring-xd-module repository to the core repository to allow native usage of the sink for writing to GPDB/HAWQ.
Implement a centralized module registry located in a GitHub repository to keep all admins and containers in the cluster in sync.
Benchmark RabbitMQ on Rackspace infrastructure to evaluate how it scales as more xd-container nodes are added.
Add improvements to existing Flo parser endpoints to streamline the error reporting strategy.
Update the Mail source to connect to secured IMAP and/or SMTP mail servers using java-mail properties for SSL/TLS.

activities.activity_name: HDFS default for custom module registry & YARN cleanup
activities.activity_description: Default to HDFS as the distributed remote location for the custom module registry and remove the custom-modules.zip artifact from the YARN distribution.
Implement automatic configuration for the xd-shell against a pre-configured environment using an init file.
Implement an option to gracefully shutdown a stream upon undeployment, ensuring messages complete their journey to the sink before XD stops the stream.
Perform comprehensive integration and system testing across all newly implemented features and modified components.
Update project documentation, including user guides and developer references, to reflect the new features and changes.
